source.citation: Chivhenge, E., Weiskittel, A. R., Ray, D., Woodall, C. W., D'Amato, A. W. and Daigneault, A. Evaluating relative density-stand dynamics relationships across contrasting forest types of the conterminous United States. Submitted to Forest Ecology and Management.
source.doi_note: Concept DOI; Supplementary Data S1 is unchanged across versions.
source.rd_definition: Breakpoints are in projected relative density (RD).

national.note: Headline national breakpoints in projected RD (all types pooled), and the pooled type by ecoregion cell means with 95% prediction intervals for a new cell.

source_codes.fp: cell fitted and pooled: the cell had its own fit and it entered the pooled estimate
source_codes.fx: cell fitted, excluded: the cell had its own fit but it was excluded from pooling (edge or few replicates)
source_codes.po: pooled only: thin cell, the value is the pooled type by ecoregion estimate

state_l3_note: EPA Level III ecoregions intersecting each state, computed from public/geo/us_eco_l3_features.geojson and public/geo/us-states.geojson by grid sampling each ecoregion polygon and locating the samples in state polygons (pure Python ray casting); a state is listed when at least 3 samples fall in it. Geojson NA_L3NAME matched to the CSV L3NAME, with 10 North American to US name aliases. Ecoregions in the geojson with no forest cells in Supplementary Data S1 are not listed: Central California Valley, Chihuahuan Desert.
